question: /ACC_PWR_EN has been NO_PATH for six decisions.  What actually holds it?
finding: ONE corridor runs from the U16 / community region into the U2-U3 expander pair,
and /BQ25185_STAT1 was holding it with a 115.638 mm, 45-object WESTERN LOOP that
left U11.9, crossed the whole middle of the board to x = 46.5, and came back east
to U2.20.  Ripping that loop closes /ACC_PWR_EN every time; the loop then cannot
re-lay and the board is no better off.  That is what D-728 and D-731 both measured.
The way out is that AN EXPANDER PIN IS A FREE VARIABLE (D-732), and BQ25185_STAT1's
own copper already passes 1.175 mm from U3.20.  So STAT1 does not need the corridor
at all -- it needs a DIFFERENT PIN, 1.025 mm away, and that releases U2.20 for
/ACC_PWR_EN, which its 54.57 mm route reaches through the freed channel.

why_it_is_neutral: U2 and U3 are both PCAL9535APW on the SAME internal I2C bus (0x20 / 0x21), both
powered from +3V3, and both wire-OR their open-drain INT onto WAKE_INT_N, so which
device owns a bit changes no behaviour.
U2 P17 becomes this port's only OUTPUT: 07h goes FFh -> 7Fh.  Safe state is
unchanged -- the PCAL9535A powers up with every pin an input and R17's 100 k holds
the TCA4307 disabled until firmware drives it.
U3 P17 becomes an INPUT with R127's 10 k pull-up, exactly as it was on U2.

why_the_lattice_mattered: At --grid 50000 the same route is 54.10 mm and introduces ONE copper_sliver on
In2.Cu, which the gate refuses as attributable DRC.  At --grid 25000 the route is
54.57 mm -- 0.47 mm LONGER -- and DRC is clean.  The sliver was a lattice artefact
of the coarse pitch, not a property of the corridor.

Their escapes exist but open into a pocket closed by the 1.300 mm F.Cu BAT_PROTECTED_P trunk, which passes y = 74.08 at x = 59.862 -- 0.35 mm from U3.13's own land.

The router honours it, but real KiCad DRC then reports three track_width errors against the .kicad_dru rule 'Pad-escape necking - width, fine-pitch power packages', whose 0.200 mm minimum binds inside the U9/U11/U12/U13/U14/U16/U17/U20/U21/U22 courtyards -- so the class cannot carry any net that must escape one of those ten packages.  Reverted.
